trials.claim: Lifetime deal for one-time $59 payment includes unlimited tokens and AI generators
trials.claimQuote: Yes, nichesss offers a lifetime deal for a one-time payment of $59, which includes unlimited tokens, AI marketing copy generation, AI idea generation, and more.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report the account was limited to 1000 generations rather than unlimited tokens, and that AI article tools required a further upgrade despite the lifetime purchase.

exhibits.quote: NOT Unlimited Tokens. 1000 generations available ≠ Unlimited Tokens
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports account limited to 1000 generations, contradicting unlimited tokens promise.

exhibits.quote: To use our AI powered ✨ article generation tools, like our chrome extension, you need to upgrade your account.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime purchase still requires paid upgrade to use AI article tools, undermining included-generators claim.

exhibits.quote: Free trial, no contracts. $59 Lifetime Deal. 30 day money back guarantee.
exhibits.argument: Vendor page confirms a $59 lifetime deal offer.

exhibits.quote: With unlimited tokens at your disposal, Nichesss allows you to generate high-quality content without the constraints of traditional writing tools.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms lifetime deal includes unlimited tokens for generating content.

trials.claim: Offers 60-day money-back guarantee to try the platform for two months
trials.claimQuote: Yes, nichesss offers a 60-day money-back guarantee, allowing users to try the platform for two months to ensure it meets their needs.
trials.reasoning: The vendor's own homepage states a 30 day money back guarantee, not the claimed 60 days.

exhibits.quote: Free trial, no contracts. $59 Lifetime Deal. 30 day money back guarantee.
exhibits.argument: Vendor's own homepage states 30 day guarantee, not 60 days.

trials.claim: Support via email at help@nichesss.com or via help page
trials.claimQuote: For support, you can email nichesss at [email protected] or visit their help page for more information.
trials.reasoning: The vendor's terms list help@nichesss.com as an official contact email, and a buyer confirms it is the support box; reports of slow replies do not contradict that the email channel exists.

exhibits.quote: For a simple question sent to their support box: help@nichesss.com, I waited 4 days with no response.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports emailing support address and receiving no response for 4 days.

exhibits.quote: But there was no follow up what so ever and our issue was simply forgotten.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports support request sent by email was ignored and forgotten.

exhibits.quote: You can contact us by phone at 2106455626, email at [email protected], or by mail to 8435 ORION AVE SUITE 406, Los Angeles, CA 91343, United States.
exhibits.argument: Vendor terms list help@nichesss.com as official contact email.

exhibits.quote: For a simple question sent to their support box: help@nichesss.com, I waited 4 days with no response.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms help@nichesss.com is the support email box.

trials.claim: Get content, images and profitable ideas for any niche in 60 seconds or less
trials.claimQuote: Get amazing content + images + profitable ideas for any niche in 60 seconds or less
trials.reasoning: The vendor promises content and ideas in seconds, but no exhibit shows images or profitable ideas for any niche within 60 seconds, and buyer reports raise doubts without directly proving timing.

exhibits.quote: Can you help me - how do I find profitable niches or any niche in my target audience.
exhibits.argument: Buyer cannot find advertised profitable-niche feature, undermining any-niche ideas claim.

exhibits.quote: I’ve regenerated the output more than 50 times, but it always ends up being unable to finish the description until the end.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports outputs repeatedly incomplete after many tries, contradicting fast amazing content claim.

exhibits.quote: Forget writers block. Get blog posts, ads, social media content, poems, business ideas and more by just clicking a button.
exhibits.argument: Vendor promises content and ideas by just clicking a button.

exhibits.quote: We’ll generate what you need in seconds. Try our tools now and see how they work for you.
exhibits.argument: Vendor promises generation in seconds.

trials.claim: Provides over 150 AI-powered tools to generate content quickly
trials.claimQuote: Nichesss provides over 150 AI-powered tools to help users generate content quickly.
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports most features tried were marked Upgrade Required, materially limiting the claim that over 150 tools are provided with the purchase.

exhibits.quote: Most of the features I tried were >>>> Upgrade Required
exhibits.argument: Buyer found most tools locked behind upgrade, so 150 tools are not actually provided with purchase.

exhibits.quote: Too many small tools but not very helpful.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the many small tools are not helpful for quick generation.

exhibits.quote: Its over 150 options are a dream come true as I have varied work requirements and Nicesss fills them quickly without stumbling
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms over 150 options that fill work requirements quickly.

exhibits.quote: From blog posts, to Facebook & Google Ads, business ideas, and even poems we generate it all.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms it generates many content types quickly.

trials.claim: Can create blog posts, marketing copy, DALL-E 2 images and discover profitable niches
trials.claimQuote: Features include creating blog posts, marketing copy, AI-generated images powered by DALL·E 2, and discovering profitable niches within target audiences.
trials.reasoning: Exhibits support blog posts and ads and only art prompts for use with DALL-E 2, not actual DALL-E 2 image creation or profitable niche discovery.

exhibits.quote: The long form editor of Nichesss is the worse than one can even imagine.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports long-form blog creation feature performs worst imaginable, undermining blog-post capability.

exhibits.quote: And now I'm presented with another ai copywriting tool.
exhibits.argument: Buyer seeking profitable-niche discovery found only another copywriting tool instead.

exhibits.quote: Helps you generates art prompts to use with nichesss, DALLE-2 or Stable Diffusion
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms DALLE-2 powered image generation feature.

exhibits.quote: From blog posts, to Facebook & Google Ads, business ideas, and even poems we generate it all.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms blog posts and ads generation capability.
